title: NITDGP-Thesis-Template-Unofficial: Professional LaTeX Template for NIT Durgapur Thesis (UG/PG/PhD)
description: An unofficial, professional-grade LaTeX thesis template designed for undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral students at National Institute of Technology Durgapur (NIT Durgapur). The template provides automated formatting, multi-student support (up to 3 students for UG, 1 for PG/PhD), latexmk integration, MATLAB code highlighting via mcode.sty, comprehensive error handling, and full institutional compliance with academic presentation standards. It is an alumni initiative developed to ease the thesis-writing experience for the NITDGP community. Features include: professional A4 formatting, conditional multi-student rendering, integrated photo handling for author biographies, customizable headers/footers/title pages, justified text without hyphenation, and complete frontmatter/backmatter templates.
